'''Decipher promotional videos''' are the television commercials and promotional videos Decipher made for its card games. Few survive online; the known copies were posted to YouTube by fans years later.

== Star Wars CCG ==

* ''Star Wars CCG – TV Ad (1996)'', a 31-second television commercial, posted on 14 December 2020.<ref name="yt-IXsMeCs8sZo">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IXsMeCs8sZo Star Wars CCG - TV Ad (1996)], Lusco-fusco (14 December 2020).</ref>

== WARS TCG ==

Decipher launched the [[WARS TCG]] in 2004 after losing the Star Wars license.
* ''WARS Introduction Video'' (21 minutes), posted on 18 October 2011.<ref name="yt-RFBErd9jMVM">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RFBErd9jMVM WARS Introduction Video], arcbeatle (18 October 2011).</ref>
* ''WARS Television Commercial'' (45 seconds), posted on 18 October 2011.<ref name="yt-j-wna46wfDE">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j-wna46wfDE WARS Television Commercial], arcbeatle (18 October 2011).</ref>

Decipher also promoted WARS on its weekly audio show, [[WARS Radio|Decipher WARS Radio]] (2004–05).
